rows.grounds: compound name of the goddess Jñāna-Sarasvatī, standard of comparison
compound listing ritual practices with ādika indicating inclusion of similar acts

items.question: Which ritual practices for Tripurā are equivalent to those of Jñāna-Sarasvatī?
premises: Tripurā's ritual practices are declared equal to Jñāna-Sarasvatī's.
The specified practices include meditation, installation, and worship.
The term ādika extends equivalence to related ritual acts.
items.inference: Meditation, installation, worship, and similar practices prescribed for Tripurā correspond to those of Jñāna-Sarasvatī.
uncertainties: The exact scope of practices included by ādikam is not specified.
items.plain_english: For Tripurā, meditation, installation, worship, and similar practices are the same as those for Jñāna-Sarasvatī.
